jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p style="line-height: 1.2;">&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><strong>About Gusto</strong></p> <p>At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.</p> <p>&nbsp;<br>All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/total-rewards" target="_blank"> <u>Total Rewards philosophy</u></a>.</p> <p>&nbsp;<br>AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a key member of Enterprise Applications IT (EAIT), the Legal Tech IT Product Manager owns the AI-first strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the enterprise applications supporting Gusto’s Legal &amp; Compliance organization. This is an AI-forward product role: you will reimagine how legal and compliance work gets done by embedding generative AI, AI agents, and intelligent automation into systems like contract lifecycle management (CLM), matter and legal-spend management, e-signature, entity and corporate records management, legal hold and e-discovery, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms.</p> <p>Acting as the primary interface between Legal &amp; Compliance teams and EAIT delivery resources, you will translate business needs into well-defined, AI-enabled product requirements, guide solution design, and drive continuous improvement across core legal and compliance processes. In line with Gusto’s enterprise systems strategy, you will help shift legal operations from reactive, manual workflows to predictive, context-aware, and self-improving platforms—designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) that connect legal systems to large language models—while ensuring privilege protection, security, compliance, and measurable impact. This role blends product leadership and deep systems knowledge with strong AI literacy and a bias toward applying AI to every part of the legal technology stack.</p> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Enterprise Applications IT (EAIT) team drives the intelligent transformation of Gusto’s enterprise systems, integrating AI, automation, and advanced analytics across our internal applications ecosystem to improve scalability, efficiency, and decision-making. EAIT builds MCPs, AI agents, and intelligent workflows that connect systems and make enterprise processes smarter, faster, and more predictive, while providing reliable, secure, and scalable application platforms for critical business processes.</p> <p>Within EAIT, this role provides dedicated, AI-forward product ownership for the Legal &amp; Compliance technology domain, complementing existing product and platform owners to establish a mature, well-governed, and increasingly autonomous enterprise applications operating model. This is a new role, designed to expand the team’s capacity to operationalize AI within legal and compliance workflows and modernize the systems behind that work.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do Day-to-Day</strong></h3> <h4><strong>AI-First Product Ownership &amp; Roadmap (Legal &amp; Compliance Technology)</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own the product vision, AI roadmap, and backlog for the legal and compliance technology portfolio within EAIT, with AI and automation as the default lens for every initiative.</li> <li>Set a multi-year vision for an AI-augmented legal function, identifying where generative AI, AI agents, and automation can eliminate manual effort, accelerate cycle times, and improve quality and risk outcomes.</li> <li>Align roadmap priorities with Legal &amp; Compliance leadership, EAIT’s AI transformation strategy, and enterprise architecture standards.</li> <li>Define success metrics and outcomes—including AI adoption, automation rate, accuracy, cycle-time reduction, and cost-to-serve—to measure business value and system effectiveness.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>AI, Automation &amp; Agentic Workflows</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design and deliver generative-AI capabilities across the legal stack: AI-assisted contract drafting, review, redlining, clause extraction, and risk flagging; AI summarization of matters, contracts, and legal documents; and natural-language search across legal knowledge.</li> <li>Build and productize AI agents that execute or augment core legal and compliance processes—such as legal intake triage and routing, NDA and standard-contract self-service, obligation and renewal tracking, policy Q&amp;A, and regulatory-change monitoring.</li> <li>Define and prioritize Model Context Protocols (MCPs) and integrations that securely connect legal systems (CLM, matter management, document management, GRC) to large language models and orchestration frameworks.</li> <li>Apply retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over contracts, policies, and legal knowledge bases to deliver grounded, citable answers for legal and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Evaluate, pilot, and scale AI legal-tech vendors and native AI features (e.g., contract AI, AI assistants, e-discovery AI), running structured proofs-of-concept and build-vs-buy assessments.</li> <li>Establish evaluation and quality processes for AI features—prompt design, model selection and tradeoffs, accuracy and hallucination testing, human-in-the-loop review, and continuous tuning.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Business Process &amp; Solution Design</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end, AI-augmented redesign of core legal workflows—contract lifecycle management, matter intake and management, outside-counsel and legal-spend (e-billing), e-signature, entity and corporate records management, and legal hold and e-discovery.</li> <li>Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and solution designs—including where AI augments, automates, or fully owns a step, and where humans stay in the loop—for EAIT delivery teams.</li> <li>Ensure solutions are scalable, auditable, and aligned with data privacy, security, internal controls, and compliance standards, including protection of privileged and sensitive information in all AI workflows.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Enterprise Applications Enablement</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Partner with EAIT engineers, administrators, AI architects, and platform owners to design and deliver enhancements, integrations, MCPs, and AI agents across legal technology platforms.</li> <li>Review and approve configurations, workflows, integrations, prompts, and agent designs to ensure they meet business, legal, and IT governance requirements.</li> <li>Guide prioritization of enhancements, AI capabilities, upgrades, and technical-debt remediation across legal-managed platforms.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Stakeholder Partnership &amp; Delivery</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary EAIT point of contact for Legal &amp; Compliance stakeholders and as a champion for AI-first ways of working across the legal function.</li> <li>Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of requests, balancing stakeholder needs with EAIT capacity and the AI roadmap.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional initiatives from discovery through deployment, ensuring clear communication, change management, and timely execution.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Responsible AI, Controls, Privacy &amp; Insights</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Govern the full lifecycle of AI agents and MCPs in the legal domain, ensuring responsible-AI practices: guardrails, privilege protection, data governance, access controls, auditability, and human oversight.</li> <li>Partner with Legal, IT risk, Security, and audit teams to ensure AI-enabled systems and processes support privacy, regulatory, and SOX-related requirements and safeguard attorney-client privilege and sensitive data.</li> <li>Define and oversee KPIs and operational metrics for legal and compliance systems, including AI accuracy, reliability, adoption, and ROI.</li> <li>Collaborate with data, BI, and AI teams to deliver dashboards, analytics, and AI-driven insights that support data-driven legal operations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Change Management, AI Enablement &amp; Adoption</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Drive successful adoption of new AI capabilities through training, documentation, prompt and playbook libraries, and hands-on change management.</li> <li>Coach legal and compliance teams on safe, effective, and confident use of AI tools, and act as the subject-matter expert for legal AI and technology within EAIT, promoting best practices and standardization.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.</li> <li>8+ years of experience in enterprise applications, legal operations / legal technology, business systems, or product management, with hands-on expertise supporting legal and/or compliance functions.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience delivering AI-powered products or features—generative AI / large language models, AI assistants, or intelligent automation—ideally within legal, compliance, or enterprise applications, with a clear bias toward applying AI to solve business problems.</li> <li>Working knowledge of leading LLM platforms (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and core GenAI techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and guardrails, with the ability to reason about model tradeoffs.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI agent and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) and Model Context Protocols (MCPs), and experience integrating AI with enterprise systems is a strong plus.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with legal technology platforms such as contract lifecycle management (e.g., Ironclad, Agiloft, DocuSign CLM), matter management and e-billing (e.g., SimpleLegal, Brightflag, Legal Tracker), e-signature (e.g., DocuSign), entity management, legal hold / e-discovery, and/or GRC tools—including their native AI capabilities.</li> <li>Experience evaluating, selecting, and deploying AI legal-tech vendors and running proofs-of-concept and build-vs-buy assessments.</li> <li>Strong commitment to responsible, secure, and explainable AI, with experience embedding privacy, privilege protection, audit controls, and SOX-aligned governance into AI-enabled workflows.</li> <li>Experience owning or managing enterprise application products within an IT or EAIT-style organization, and the ability to translate business needs into product roadmaps, functional requirements, and delivered solutions.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to partner effectively across Legal, Compliance, IT, and executive leadership, with excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to influence without authority.</li> <li>Growth mindset and the ability to operate in ambiguity, define standards where none exist, and scale AI solutions from proof-of-concept to enterprise-wide adoption.</li> <li>Relevant certifications (PMP, product management, AI/ML, or legal operations / CLM certifications) are a plus.</li> </ul> <p>Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $221,000-247,000 in San Francisco Bay Area. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately <strong>2-3 days </strong>per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.</span></p> <p>Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.&nbsp;</p> <p>When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.</p> <hr> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdEfl7Bp-Twz7LLlhGlha46CrxZ9Kacgakmarf3K2TbnaEgKQ/viewform">this form</a> and a member of our team will get in touch with you.</span></p> <p>Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our <a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/fraudulent-activity-disclaimer">Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer</a>.</p> <p>Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to&nbsp;<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/applicant-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div>

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Credit & Pricing
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>About the Product team&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for an outstanding product manager who is not bound by the existing paradigms of traditional banks. This role is part of the Credit &amp; Pricing Product team, responsible for consumer credit, underwriting, merchant pricing, and loan economics across the entire portfolio of merchants and channel partnerships. In joining this team, you will be at the center of Affirm’s credit &amp; pricing strategy to expand our footprint into new verticals and product offerings. The team drives innovative solutions that fuel all end user experiences in the US and globally while partnering with a wide variety of teams including but not limited to product, engineering, analytics, design, marketing, legal, capital, commercial and more.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Define and drive product strategy in collaboration with your peers in Credit &amp; Pricing engineering, analytics, and go-to-market teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define new products and features with specs and prototypes that enable merchants to offer consumers attractive financing terms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze the impact of product features and define metrics for success.</p> </li> <li> <p>Establish yourself as a trusted partner of our Credit, Pricing, Commercial, Design, and Engineering teams to successfully launch and scale products.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate across product teams to support initiatives that interface with Affirm’s Credit &amp; Pricing capabilities (e.g., international expansion, large merchant integrations, new product verticals, cost optimizations).</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Motivation: You have a passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better.</p> </li> <li> <p>Analytical skills: You have a data-driven learning style and use quantitative information to make product decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experimental mindset: You like to test and learn in a way that incorporates both customer needs and data. You must be comfortable operating autonomously and unafraid to learn/fail fast.</p> </li> <li> <p>Results: Experience shipping simple, elegant user-facing products with measurable impact to the bottom line.</p> </li> <li> <p>Product experience: Minimum 3-4 years of prior product or relevant experience in consumer finance, payments, underwriting, and machine learning models.</p> </li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, or other related fields; or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Pay Grade - N</p> <p>Equity Grade - 6</p> <p><br>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.<br><br>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)<br><br>CAN base pay range per year: $153,000 - $213,000</p> <p>This posting is for an existing vacancy.<br><br>#LI-Remote</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.</span></p> <p class="p1">[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.</p> </div></div>

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Resource Management
jobs.description: <p>Every large organization has the same problem: too many projects, not enough visibility into who's actually available to do the work. Operations teams, PMOs, and professional services firms are making staffing decisions in spreadsheets, guessing at utilization, and finding out they're over-capacity after it's too late. Resource Management (RM) is Asana's answer to that problem — and we're at an inflection point in how we think about it.&nbsp;</p> <p>RM has strong foundations and proven enterprise demand, but it was built for a pre-agentic world. The next version of this product looks fundamentally different: AI Teammates that monitor utilization in real time, flag staffing risk before it hits delivery, recommend rebalancing across teams and projects, and automate the operational overhead that makes resource planning so painful today. We believe this capability is worth investing in seriously — not just as a feature within Asana's broader platform, but potentially as a standalone commercial offering for enterprise buyers whose primary need is resource visibility, not work management.</p> <p>As a Staff Product Manager leading this reinvention, you'll own the full RM product strategy — global capacity planning, skills-based staffing, time tracking, utilization reporting, and the agentic workflows that make all of it proactive rather than reactive. The strategic questions are genuinely open: what does RM look like as a reimagined agentic product, who is the right buyer, and how do we price and position it as a commercial offering in its own right? This role shapes those answers.</p> <p>This role is based in our New York office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll achieve</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Drive the product strategy and execution</strong> for the next generation of Asana's Resource Management offering, establishing a clear roadmap to transition from a reactive tracking tool into a proactive, agentic platform.</li> <li><strong>Define and validate the market opportunity</strong> for RM as a potential standalone enterprise commercial offering, answering critical open strategic questions around positioning, monetization, and buyer personas.</li> <li><strong>Design and deploy AI-driven capabilities</strong> (such as AI Teammates) that automatically monitor real-time utilization, predict staffing risks, and generate proactive rebalancing recommendations across complex enterprise teams.</li> <li><strong>Partner deeply with cross-functional stakeholders</strong> across Product Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Product Marketing to build, test, and ship highly impactful, scalable solutions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About you</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. History product area in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer-facing conversations, including enterprise account escalations and executive briefings</li> <li>Partner with engineering on-call and support teams to triage and prioritise customer-impacting production issues in the Audit &amp; History space</li> <li>Define success metrics for every feature you ship and partner with data and analytics teams to ensure proper instrumentation, dashboards, and reporting from day one</li> <li>Contribute to pricing and packaging decisions for new and existing Audit &amp; History capabilities, working alongside pricing, sales, and GTM to position offerings effectively</li> <li>Collaborate effectively with engineering and design team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaborative product delivery</li> <li>Perform other duties as assigned</li> </ul> <p><strong>You Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product management experience, including delivering impactful enterprise SaaS or B2B software solutions</li> <li>Experience owning audit, compliance, observability, governance, or data management product areas is a strong plus</li> <li>Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex platform problem spaces and make clear scoping decisions across multiple engineering teams</li> <li>Strong customer instincts—you know how to run discovery, find signal in noisy feedback, and translate it into well-scoped product decisions</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity</li> <li>Comfort working across multiple engineering teams and time zones, including stakeholders in North America</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to represent the product area in leadership reviews and directly with enterprise customers</li> <li>Data-driven mindset with a focus on adoption, reliability, and trust metrics to guide prioritisation and measure outcomes</li> <li>Experience working alongside AI/ML product areas, or shipping audit and observability features for AI-driven systems, is a plus</li> <li>Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis</li> <li>Fluency in English is required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Get to Know Us:</strong></p> <p>At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong></p> <p>Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. jobs.description: <p><img style="max-width: 100%;" src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/61a5868fbaa6ba287e749ca1/77ff2cd5-09c8-4a61-88bd-787add2597f1/SHOT_06_INVESTOR_DATA_MM_220322_099.jpg" width="800"></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p>YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.</p> <p>Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.</p> <p>We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by <em>Inc.</em> as a <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/yipitdata">Best Workplace</a> for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.</p> <p><strong>What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:</strong></p> <p>YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.</p> <p>From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.</p> <p>Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership That Matters</strong>: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes</li> <li><strong>Rapid Growth</strong>: We compress years of learning into months</li> <li><strong>Merit Over Titles</strong>: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure</li> <li><strong>Velocity with Purpose: </strong>We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention</li> </ul> <p>If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.</p> <p><strong>About The Role:</strong></p> <p>YipitData’s Corporate team collaborates directly with organizations like Ulta, 3M, and Scotts Miracle-Gro to build one of the most comprehensive views into how consumers in the U.S. are purchasing and engaging with brands. By transforming massive volumes of consumer data into accurate, reliable, and actionable insights, we enable our clients to understand not just <em>what</em> is happening in their businesses, but <em>why</em>—and to use that understanding to make higher-confidence decisions in an increasingly competitive landscape.&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of our continued growth, we are expanding the Data team within our Corporate practice and are excited to welcome a Director of Product Classification to help deliver the most accurate category insights to our Retail and Brands clients.&nbsp;</p> <p>As an Associate Director, Product Classification, you will be the operational leader of our Product Classification organization — the team responsible for ensuring every product in our datasets is accurately categorized to meet the precise needs of our clients. You'll own the people, processes, and accountability frameworks that drive classification accuracy at scale, while maintaining excellent cross-functional partnerships with Engineering, Data, and our client-facing teams.</p> <p>This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in ambiguity &amp; rapid growth. You will be hands-on in building and managing a multi-layered team — including a Data Classification and a Manual Data Quality team — and you'll be responsible for recruiting, training, and creating a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement. You'll set the metrics that hold people accountable, build the systems that make the team scalable, and ensure our classification quality is best-in-class.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US.</strong> However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. <strong>We expect East Coast work hours.</strong></p> <p><strong>As Our Associate Director of Product Classification, You Will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own operational leadership and accountability for the Product Classification organization</strong></li> <ul> <li>Build and own the metrics framework that holds every team member accountable for classification accuracy, throughput, and quality.</li> <li>Establish clear performance standards, SLAs, and escalation paths across the Data Classification and Data Quality teams.</li> <li>Run a rigorous operating cadence — standups, reviews, retrospectives — that surfaces issues early and drives continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Recruit, train, and develop a high-performing classification team</strong></li> <ul> <li>Hire and onboard Data Classification Analysts who are obsessed with accurate outcomes and hungry to deeply learn what clients need in each category.</li> <li>Build and scale your team, ensuring they can execute consistently on well-defined processes.</li> <li>Create onboarding programs, training curricula, and knowledge bases that accelerate ramp time and reduce institutional knowledge risk.</li> <li>Ensure analysts own the LLM prompt for each category, continuously refining prompts based on error patterns and client feedback.</li> <li>Oversee the creation of scalable analytic checks that detect patterns of potential errors that neither the LLM nor manual checking can catch.</li> <li>Ensure the team builds and maintains rules based on deep category expertise — key products, franchises, brands, and how they should be categorized.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Build and maintain a culture of operational excellence</strong></li> <ul> <li>Foster a team culture where accuracy is non-negotiable, curiosity is rewarded, and everyone takes ownership of outcomes.</li> <li>Create an environment where Data Classification analysts are empowered to go deep — learning the nuances of client needs, franchise structures, brand hierarchies, and how products should be categorized.</li> <li>Champion knowledge sharing across the team so that expertise scales beyond individual contributors.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Maintain excellent cross-functional relationships with Engineering, Insights, and Data to drive our mapping capabilities further. Partner</strong><strong>&nbsp;with the Product Manager on system architecture and roadmap</strong></li> <ul> <li>Work closely with the PM (who owns the classification system architecture and vision) to ensure operational feasibility and team readiness for new initiatives.</li> <li>Provide ground-level feedback on what's working, what's breaking, and where the biggest accuracy gaps exist to inform the PM's roadmap.</li> <li>Ensure seamless handoff between the PM's process design and the team's execution.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Leverage AI to accelerate and improve our classification systems to be faster and more accurate</strong></li> <ul> <li>Partner with Engineering and the PM to continuously improve LLM-driven classification, using the team's domain expertise to train and evaluate models.</li> <li>Identify opportunities where AI/automation can replace or augment manual work and lead the operational transition.</li> <li>Stay current on advancements in NLP, LLMs, and classification technology to inform team strategy.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>You Are Likely To Succeed If:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have <strong>8+ years of experience</strong> in data analytics, data operations, category mapping, or consulting, with at least 4+ years leading teams of 10+, and at least 2 years of experience managing team leaders.&nbsp;</li> <li>You have 2+ years of experience working with <em>SQL, Python, PySpark</em>, or other programming languages to explore and transform large, complex datasets; Familiarity with GitHub and Databricks</li> <li>You have an operational excellence mindset — you build systems, metrics, and processes that scale. You hold people accountable without micromanaging.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of hiring great talent, building training programs, and developing leaders within your team.&nbsp;</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and building from scratch — this is a team-building role. You'll be creating structure, not inheriting it.</li> <li>You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing</li> <li>You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company</li> <li><strong><em>Preferred</em></strong><strong>:</strong> Data and classification domain experience (preferred) — experience with product taxonomies, categorization systems, e-commerce data, or similar domains is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer:</strong></p> <p><strong>Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!</li> <li>Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!</li> <li><strong>The annual on-target earnings for this position is anticipated to be up to $210K ~ $220K + bonus element. The final offer may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, as well as internal team benchmarks.&nbsp;</strong></li> <li>The compensation package also includes equity.</li> </ul> <p><em>We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</em></p> <p><a href="https://www.yipitdata.com/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice">Job Applicant Privacy Notice</a></p>

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Agent Observability
jobs.description: ABOUT LIVEKIT LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year. ABOUT THIS ROLE We're looking for a Product Manager to own LiveKit's Agent Observability product: how teams understand, debug, and trust what their voice agents do in production. Our PM team is small and high-leverage, with each PM coming in to establish the foundations in a new area of the business. Observability is one of the most important new products at LiveKit. It's central to our strategy, a surface of huge value to customers, and a category still in its infancy. You'd own it as the sole PM. You'll set the vision and roadmap for the whole observability suite, from traces and recordings to dashboards, evals, and quality metrics, and partner closely with the engineering team that builds it. The product has to serve two very different users at once: the engineer debugging why a call went wrong, and the non-technical operator reviewing quality, cost, and agent behavior. That makes it as hard at the UX layer as it is under the hood. The category for voice AI observability is being defined right now, and you'll be shaping a product used by some of the largest companies deploying voice agents at scale. YOU'LL THRIVE AT LIVEKIT IF YOU: - are obsessed with making the best product for our customers - are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems - work hard and can build and ship fast - are focused on polish, detail, and quality - are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills The best way to impress us is by trying LiveKit’s product, understanding the space, and bringing smart thoughts and opinions to the table. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the observability roadmap. Set a clear vision and a sequenced plan for the suite, and decide what gets built and when, in partnership with engineering. - Ship products people rely on. Turn a complex, data-dense problem into experiences customers use every day, and keep raising the bar on quality. - Make agent quality measurable. Build the evals and metrics teams need to know whether their agents are actually good and getting better, from latency and cost to conversation quality and behavior. - Design for two audiences at once. Make the product work for deeply technical users and non-technical operators without compromising either. - Get deep with customers and data. Understand how teams actually run and debug agents in production, and let that shape priorities. - Grow it into a business. Drive adoption and revenue so our observability revenue reflects the real value it delivers to customers. WHO YOU ARE - 8+ years in product management, at a senior or staff level, ideally having owned a developer-facing or data-heavy product. - Technical depth. You can reason about how a complex system works under the hood and earn the trust of strong engineers. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand systems well enough to make good tradeoffs. - Multi-persona product sense. You've built for both deeply technical users and non-technical ones in the same product, and have the design judgment to make dense, data-rich interfaces genuinely useful. - Cross-functional influence. LiveKit's engineering teams operate with high autonomy. You influence through clarity, trust, and good judgment, not process or hierarchy. - Communication as a superpower. You write clearly, present well, and can move between a board-level strategy conversation and a detailed technical discussion with an engineering lead. - Comfort with ambiguity. We're a small product team at a fast-growing company. You'll figure out what matters, prioritize ruthlessly, and move quickly without perfect information. NICE TO HAVE - Built an observability, monitoring, or analytics product, or a tool for evaluating and improving AI/LLM quality - Familiarity with evals, tracing, or quality measurement for AI/LLM or agent systems - Familiarity with how teams debug and monitor software in production (logs, traces, metrics, dashboards) - Background at a developer tools or infrastructure company - Familiarity with voice AI, real-time communication, or telephony - Experience with usage-based pricing models OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU - An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world - Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers - Competitive salary and equity package - Health, dental, and vision benefits - Flexible vacation policy LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Growth
jobs.description: About WorkOS 🚀 WorkOS builds modern developer tools and APIs that make it easy for companies to become Enterprise Ready. Our platform powers authentication, identity, authorization, and other critical infrastructure that developers need to securely scale their products to large organizations. We recently raised a $100M Series C, valuing the company at $2B, led by Meritech and Sapphire with participation from Greenoaks, Craft, Abstract, and Audacious. WorkOS powers enterprise features for many of the fastest-growing AI companies, including OpenAI, Cursor, and Perplexity, Vercel, and Plaid. As AI reshapes software, WorkOS is at the frontier of Human and Agent Authentication, Identity, and Access Control—helping companies answer a new critical question: who are your agents, and what are they allowed to do? Our fast-growing customer base includes hundreds of modern software companies building the next generation of enterprise-ready products. ABOUT THE ROLE Growth at WorkOS spans the entire customer journey. From a developer's first API call to enterprise deployment, you'll identify where customers find value, where they get stuck, and how we help them grow. You'll own activation, adoption, monetization, expansion, and retention across the platform. You'll define how we measure success, build our experimentation practice, and partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Data, and Finance to drive meaningful business outcomes. This is a high-impact role with direct influence on company growth. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own Product Growth across the WorkOS platform. - Develop the strategy for how developers discover, adopt, and expand their use of WorkOS. - Define the metrics that measure acquisition, activation, monetization, expansion, and retention. - Build and scale a product experimentation program. - Improve onboarding and reduce time-to-value for new developers. - Identify friction throughout the customer journey and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities. - Partner with Engineering and Design to ship improvements that increase customer adoption and business impact. - Work with Marketing to improve acquisition and attribution. - Partner with Sales to strengthen the product-qualified lead motion and enterprise expansion path. - Use customer research, analytics, and experimentation to guide roadmap decisions. - Communicate strategy, priorities, and results across the company. REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of Product Management experience with ownership of meaningful business outcomes. - Experience leading growth, onboarding, monetization, activation, or retention for a developer platform, API product, infrastructure company, or B2B SaaS product. - Experience with product-led growth. - Experience with API or usage-based pricing models. - Strong product instincts backed by data. - Deep experience designing and evaluating experiments. - Strong understanding of developer workflows and customer experience. - Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly. - Excellent cross-functional partner who can influence teams across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Finance. Benefits and Perks (US Only) 💖 At WorkOS, we offer resources that emphasize personal and familial well-being. We offer healthcare coverage for you and your family, including medical, dental, and vision. We offer parental leave, paid-time off and fully remote working arrangements. - 401k matching - Competitive Equity - Healthcare, dental and vision coverage - FSA, ST/LT Disability, Voluntary Life - Carrot fertility benefits - 20 days paid vacation + 10 holidays + unlimited sick leave - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave - Fitness: Monthly stipend for gyms, yoga classes, race registrations or whatever keeps you active - Wellness: Monthly stipend for a massage, meditations class, therapy, or activities that enhance your well-being - Commuter benefits for hybrid employees in SF/NYC - Unlimited token usage! Please inquire directly with our recruiting team for benefits available to those working outside the US. Equal Opportunity Employer WorkOS is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusiveness. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
